audit_items.proof_trace: generateAccessToken sets iat = now and exp = now + TOKEN_EXPIRY.ACCESS_TOKEN (2592000), so t.exp == t.iat + 2592000 holds by construction. TOKEN_EXPIRY.ACCESS_TOKEN is a compile-time constant with no runtime override path, and the only token issuance call site (route.ts:138) passes no expiry override. Note: the HTTP response field expires_in is hardcoded to 3600 (1 hour) rather than TOKEN_EXPIRY.ACCESS_TOKEN, which is an RFC 6749 §5.1 conformance defect but does not affect the JWT exp claim asserted by this property.
